scope: Frozen014bb source inspection and existing process-wide post-running-restart observer counters. Includes heterogeneous foreground/background operations. Ratios are materialization-counter ratios, not physical write amplification or per-event causal cost.
source_findings: OverlayMergePreparation.encode calls Tree.apply_batch on key-sorted selected entries.
apply_page groups writes by child, reloads/re-packs touched children and carries untouched references.
Target encoded page4096B, maximum16384B. Private publication prepares both root-with-tail and root-without-tail and deduplicates written IDs.
decision: Do not implement sorted batch apply as a new optimization; already present. Next isolate leaf-repacking/fanout and record sizes before changing layout/page target. No runtime edits or page-size tuning admitted.
